On July 1 in #strategic-pod, Gideon first posted 300 seats at 09:14. At 09:19 he wrote: "please ignore that earlier number—it is 280." He said the 300 came from a staging tab that included sandbox logins from their May rollout. The 280 is the active seats on the production roster as of July 1.

You replied in that thread asking him to update the Q3 QBR deck to the corrected roster. Note that 280 is the count as of July 1, so check it hasn't moved if the deck needs a current number.
